app_name: İnegöl Çözüm Kurs - Öğrenci ve Ön Muhasebe Yönetim Sistemi

accessibility.contrast_ratio: WCAG AA compliant (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text)

key_functionalities: Dashboard summary with daily/monthly cash flow and quick metrics
Student, Parent & School records with TC Kimlik and address details
Webcam student photo capture with live snapshot functionality
Payment Collection (Tahsilat: Nakit, Çek, Kredi Kartı, Banka Transferi + Banka Seçimi)
Installment & Remaining Balance calculation with colored status badges
Income & Expense tracking with general balance deduction
Contract Display and PDF Generation with student placeholders
Receipt (Makbuz) PDF Generation with logo and payment breakdown
universal_guidelines: Always include data-testid on interactive elements
Ensure high contrast and WCAG compliance
Use clean Turkish labels and currency formatting (₺)
No transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays
